v3.1.1 Update
Fixed missing condition icons in the standalone OBS HUD on hosts that require a login to load system images. Icons are now sent from the GM's browser as image data.

announcement.title: ⚔️ Stylish Action HUD v3.1.1
announcement.content:
v3.1.1 fixes missing condition icons in the standalone OBS HUD.

  • On hosts that require a login to load system images, condition icons are now sent from the GM's browser as image data.
